title: Fit tone slider strength to Lightroom while preserving existing recipes
notes: New edits and raw/develop imports use toneSliderVersion 1 for global and mask tone sliders. Missing versions retain the previous law. An opt-in ramp-matching converter reports approximation residuals. Camera baselines are calibrated per model; uncalibrated models contribute zero EV. Calibrated camera baselines also change existing law-0 edits with camera exposure compensation enabled; empty legacy sidecars are unchanged. The uncalibrated A7R V baseline remains +0.35 EV.
